Singapore PM Warns Against Prejudice and Racism

Singapore Prime Minister Lawrence Wong stated that prejudice against any community must never be allowed to become accepted or normalized. He emphasized that while robust debates are acceptable, they should not be used as a cover to fuel prejudice or hostility towards foreigners. Wong urged citizens to resist forces that seek to divide the nation, stating, "Let us not allow ourselves to be pulled apart."
